props.title: Today in AI and tech
props.subline: Three updates worth your next five minutes.

beats.voice: Here are today's biggest AI and tech updates.
First up. Anthropic, the company behind Claude, is now a public company.

props.label: market value at the first close

beats.voice: Its shares closed seventeen percent up on day one, giving it a market value of about one point three trillion dollars.
Next. A huge claim from the world of mathematics.
A mathematician says he has proved the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis with help from AI. It's the most discussed story on Hacker News today, and experts are still checking the work.
